layout.hierarchy: Title is the largest text (red over blue). The two large colored containers (yellow decoder, peach encoder) are the biggest visual masses and dominate the composition. Red italic region labels come next, then blue callout boxes, then small olive italic math labels; thin red/blue connector lines are the least prominent.

visual_elements.description: Unrolled DECODER RNN inside a yellow rounded rectangle, three columns left-to-right. Each column bottom-to-top: orange/tan cell-bar split into 3 segments (hidden state); upward olive arrow with italic olive 'softmax' label to its left; light-green cell-bar split into 3 segments (output distribution); upward olive arrow to italic olive output label o₁ / o₂ / o₃. Italic olive labels s₁, s₂, s₃ sit immediately right of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd orange bars. Dark-olive curved recurrent arrows loop from beneath orange bar 1 into the bottom of orange bar 2, and from beneath bar 2 into the bottom of bar 3. A red dot marks the left edge of orange bar 1 (context-vector input) receiving a red curved arrow from below-left.

Unrolled ENCODER RNN inside a peach rounded rectangle. Top row: three pink/salmon cell-bars (each split into 3–4 segments) = hidden states; a horizontal olive arrow enters bar 1 from the left; olive right-arrows connect bar 1→2 and bar 2→3, labeled h₁ and h₂ (italic, above arrows); a red dot marks the right end of bar 3 (final hidden state / context vector). Middle band: italic olive labels 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃' with upward olive arrows from the bottom row into the pink bars. Bottom row: three tan cell-bars (each split into 3 segments) with upward olive arrows rising from italic olive input labels x₁, x₂, x₃ at the very bottom.

Pink rectangle with bold red text 'Context Vector (of Whole Inputs)'. A thin straight red line runs from the encoder's red output dot down-right to this box; a separate red curved arrow runs from just below that dot up to the red dot at the decoder's first orange cell — depicting the whole-input context vector being handed from encoder to decoder.

Thin blue leader lines: from (a)'s right edge down-right to the encoder's top-right near the red output dot; from (b) down to the h₁ arrow; from (c) down to the h₂ arrow — indicating each step must wait for the previous one.

Region labels 'Decoder (RNN)' / 'Encoder (RNN)' bold italic red ~18pt. Callout text bold blue ~13–14pt, with '[2] Sequential Processing' underlined. recreation_brief: 1) Canvas: 16:9 widescreen slide (aspect ratio assumed — see validation.uncertain_items), white #FFFFFF background, sans-serif Arial-like font throughout. 2) Red content frame: #C00000 rectangle outline only (no fill), thin ~2.5pt stroke, inset ~4% from the left and right edges, top edge at ~8% of slide height, bottom edge at the slide bottom. 3) Title block — top center, ~10%–21% vertical, horizontally centered, two lines: line 1 'Traditional RNN  Seq2Seq model' bold #C00000 ~24pt; line 2 '(Challenges)' bold #0000CC ~24pt. 4) Slide-number badge — top right, ~91%–94% horizontal, ~11%–17% vertical: yellow #FFFF66 circle with olive #808000 outline, centered numeral '8' in dark #333300. 5) Decoder label — ~71%–86% horizontal, ~16%–20% vertical: bold italic #C00000 text 'Decoder (RNN)' ~18pt. 6) Decoder container — yellow #EEEE00 rounded rectangle spanning ~50%–94% horizontal, ~21%–53% vertical. 7) Decoder columns — inside the container, build 3 identical columns (centers ~x 57%, 72%, 86%), each from bottom to top: orange #FFCC66 horizontal cell-bar split into 3 segments; upward olive #808000 arrow with italic olive 'softmax' label to its left; light-green #99FF99 horizontal cell-bar split into 3 segments; upward olive #808000 arrow ending at the italic olive output label o₁ / o₂ / o₃ for columns 1 / 2 / 3. 8) Decoder annotations — italic olive s₁, s₂, s₃ placed immediately right of orange bars 1, 2, 3; dark-olive curved recurrent arrows from beneath orange bar 1 into the bottom of bar 2 and from beneath bar 2 into the bottom of bar 3; small red #FF0000 dot on the left edge of orange bar 1 (context-vector input). 9) Encoder label — ~23%–39% horizontal, ~94%–98% vertical: bold italic #C00000 text 'Encoder (RNN)' ~18pt. 10) Encoder container — peach #FFCC99 rounded rectangle spanning ~5%–51% horizontal, ~56%–92% vertical. 11) Encoder top row — at y ~61%: 3 pink #FFB0B0 horizontal cell-bars (3–4 segments each), centers ~x 16%, 30%, 43%; a horizontal olive #808000 arrow entering bar 1 from the left; olive right-arrows from bar 1 to bar 2 and from bar 2 to bar 3, labeled above with italic olive h₁ and h₂; small red #FF0000 dot at the right end of bar 3 (final hidden state / context vector). 12) Encoder middle band — italic olive labels 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃', each with an upward olive arrow into the pink bar above it. 13) Encoder bottom row — at y ~78%: 3 tan #FFCC80 horizontal cell-bars (3 segments each), each fed by an upward olive arrow from an italic olive input label x₁, x₂, x₃ placed at y ~88%. 14) Sequential-processing callout — ~5%–34% horizontal, ~32%–42% vertical: light-blue #CFE2FF rectangle with 2 centered lines of bold #0000CC ~13–14pt text — line 1 '[2] Sequential Processing' (underlined), line 2 'Can NOT do processing in Parallel'; thin blue leader line from the box's right edge down-right to the encoder's top-right near the red output dot. 15) Wait box 1 — ~6%–19% horizontal, ~48%–54% vertical: light-blue #CFE2FF rectangle with 2-line centered bold #0000CC text ('Wait' on line 1, 'Till Processing X₁' on line 2); thin blue leader line from the box down to the h₁ arrow. 16) Wait box 2 — ~22%–36% horizontal, ~47%–54% vertical: light-blue #CFE2FF rectangle with 2-line centered bold #0000CC text ('Wait' on line 1, 'Till Processing X₂' on line 2); thin blue leader line from the box down to the h₂ arrow. 17) Context-vector box — ~58%–88% horizontal, ~75%–81% vertical: pink #FFC0CE rectangle with bold #CC0000 text 'Context Vector (of Whole Inputs)'; thin straight red #FF0000 line from the encoder's red output dot down-right to this box; separate red #FF0000 curved arrow from just below the encoder dot sweeping up to the red dot at the decoder's first orange cell. 18) Exclusion: do NOT draw the scissors-shaped cursor glyph touching the callout box's right edge — it is a video-recording overlay, not slide content.
